reasons.text: Claimed tonnage in the busiest month would need 193% of the plant's connected load running non-stop (above 100% is physically impossible)
Electricity bought is only 0.26x the minimum needed for the tonnes claimed (77 kWh/t against at least 300)
Sold products equal only 22% of the output expected from the tonnes claimed
100% of certificate tonnes were sold below the cost of recycling (average 0.31x the cost floor)
Declared capacity of 2,050 t/yr needs about 2.9x the power the plant is connected for
Certificates sold at 0.32x the market median price

model_signals.label: months with output far below input

inspection_checklist: Obtain the DISCOM consumption statement and meter readings for the flagged months; compare connected machinery (kW) against the claimed tonnage.
Reconcile product sales with processed tonnes; contact the product buyers listed and verify that they received the material.
Ask for the plant's cost sheet; certificates priced below the cost of recycling imply the processing cost was never incurred.
